name: compose-lint
description: ESLint for Docker Compose. Inline diagnostics for port conflicts, circular depends_on, undefined env vars, and deprecated Compose options. 100% local.

commands.title: Compose Lint: Lint All Compose Files

composeLint.envFileName.description: Default environment file name to cross-validate ${VAR} references against.

composeLint.checkEnvVars.description: Warn about ${VAR} references that are not defined in the environment file, service environment, or machine environment.

composeLint.checkDeprecated.description: Warn about obsolete or legacy Compose options (version, links, log_driver, etc.).

composeLint.filePatterns.description: Glob patterns of files treated as Compose files.

composeLint.maxWarningsBeforeInfo.description: Maximum number of diagnostics reported per file before degrading severities.
